headline: llm-d announces v1.0 features for operating distributed inference fleets
summary: On Oct 20, llm-d published its v1.0.0 release, tagged to commit 378b42d18dabe0b9c4ced4e6f3670d93b52db08e. The release notes align 18 core component entries around v1.0.0 and describe multi-tenant flow control, hot standby, coordinated upgrades for disaggregated serving, a stable router API and agent-aware routing. The release-specific matrix currently marks selected flow-control, prefill/decode-disaggregation, agentic-API and optimized-baseline lanes as passing. The flow-control end-to-end validator explicitly scopes its test to priority ordering; it says realistic weighted multi-tenant fairness and SLO behavior at scale needs separate inference-perf trace replay. Provider/customer throughput and cost examples remain unverified.
